skill.name: algorithmic-art
skill.description: Create original p5.js generative art from user prompts by defining an algorithmic philosophy, then producing an interactive seeded HTML artifact.
skill.summary: Turns creative prompts into seeded p5.js generative art with interactive exploration controls.

security_audit.summary: Most static command and reconnaissance findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline path formatting, comments, or JavaScript RegExp.exec(). The confirmed issues are external CDN and Google Fonts dependencies in the template, which create third-party network requests but no observed data exfiltration. No prompt-injection or malicious intent evidence was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Bundle p5.js locally or clearly document that generated artifacts contact cdnjs at runtime.
Use local fonts or system font fallbacks to avoid third-party font requests.

content.value_statement: Generative art requests often need both a clear concept and reproducible code. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to create seeded p5.js artifacts with interactive controls.
actual_capabilities: Creates an algorithmic philosophy before implementation.
Guides p5.js generative art built around seeded randomness.
Uses a provided HTML viewer template for interactive artifacts.
Defines seed navigation, parameter sliders, and optional color controls.
Supports flow fields, particles, noise systems, and recursive structures.
Encourages original art instead of copying existing artists.
limitations: Generated viewers load p5.js and fonts from external CDNs by default.
The template is incomplete until the model fills algorithm and UI handlers.
Visual quality depends on the prompt and implementation choices.
It does not provide formal copyright, trademark, or accessibility review.

use_cases.title: Prototype Interactive Art
use_cases.description: Create a browser-ready generative sketch with seed controls and adjustable parameters.

use_cases.title: Explore Visual Systems
use_cases.description: Turn an abstract theme into particles, flow fields, noise, or recursive structures.

use_cases.title: Build Reproducible Variations
use_cases.description: Generate related artwork variants by changing seeds while keeping the same algorithm.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Sketch
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one generative artwork.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an original p5.js generative artwork about calm ocean currents. Include a short algorithmic philosophy and one interactive HTML artifact.

prompt_templates.title: Add Parameter Controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Create generative art inspired by magnetic fields. Add seed navigation, sliders for field strength and particle count, and color controls.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Themed Series
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an algorithmic art system for three related seed variations based on city lights after rain. Explain how each seed changes the result.

prompt_templates.title: Refine an Advanced Artifact
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request focused on polish and performance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a polished interactive p5.js artifact using recursive growth and noise fields. Optimize performance, tune parameters, and preserve reproducible seeded output.

output_examples.input: Create art about wind moving through grass.
output_examples.output: A philosophy for emergent wind motion, plus an interactive p5.js viewer with seed controls, motion sliders, and green-toned palette controls.

output_examples.input: Make a generative system based on quantum harmonics.
output_examples.output: A seeded particle composition with phase interference, adjustable resonance parameters, and a concise explanation of the computational idea.

output_examples.input: Create 100 variations of one abstract artwork.
output_examples.output: A single algorithm that supports seed navigation, with guidance for reviewing seeds 1 through 100 inside the same viewer.

best_practices: Start with a clear theme, mood, and any required visual constraints.
Ask for seed controls and parameters that match the visual system.
Test the generated HTML in a browser before sharing it.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to copy a living artist or protected artwork.
Do not treat the template as finished production code without review.
Do not require offline-only output unless external assets are removed.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates an algorithmic art concept and a p5.js HTML artifact with interactive controls.

faq.question: Does it create reproducible results?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions require seeded randomness so the same seed should recreate the same artwork.

faq.question: Can I change the artwork after generation?
faq.answer: Yes. The generated viewer can include sliders, seed controls, and optional color controls.

faq.question: Does it work offline?
faq.answer: Not by default. The viewer template loads p5.js and Google Fonts from external URLs.

faq.question: Can I request a specific artist style?
faq.answer: The skill advises creating original algorithmic art instead of copying existing artists.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
